estimate.method: Gaussian model of every observation in the snapshot, each converted to this headline; 80% and 95% ranges calibrated by predicting 65 hidden measured headlines
estimate.screenBasis: its top screens a minimum requirement: this-grade estimates, 2 of 48 true values lay above the plausible range; its top is taken at the 98.7% point, wider than the plausible range, so that at 90% confidence at most 10% of true values lie above it; its bottom screens a maximum requirement: this-grade estimates, 1 of 48 true values lay below the plausible range; its bottom is taken at the 2.5% point so that at 90% confidence at most 10% of true values lie below it.

notApplicable.reason: HDT is a rigid-bar test. ISO 75 ends at 0.2 % outer-fibre strain, which a bar reaches once its modulus falls to about 225 MPa, so an elastomer has no meaningful HDT and makers list it as N/A. A value an elastomer's sheet publishes is shown and never decides. Sintering filaments are left out too: the finished part is the sintered metal or ceramic.
